claim: A pace window's own overhead at 28 MHz is scaled by K like the work inside it, so count it as debt or a constant or the target drifts.

evidence.text: A nested debt reading at each of up to six plots added about a line of error each, scaled by K (37 lines of target), enough to miss a frame at a room change; one reading at the end of the pass fixed it.
evidence.quote: A nested debt reading at each of up to six plots adds about a line of error each, scaled by K: 37 lines of target, enough to miss a frame at a room change.

evidence.text: A nested hook's measuring work falls outside the library's readings; about 100 nested hooks in a scroll strip add 2% unless counted as a constant (C_LIB).
evidence.quote: with about 100 nested hooks in a scroll strip it adds 2% unless counted as a constant (C_LIB).

evidence.text: The window's own hook time goes to the debt by W_PASS and W_FIX, as K would scale it.
evidence.quote: the window's own hook time goes to the debt by W_PASS and W_FIX, as K would scale it.

evidence.text: Pattern work is debt, including the window's own 28 MHz overhead; window overhead at 28 MHz is multiplied by K, so it is accounted as debt or the target grows.
evidence.quote: Window overhead at 28 MHz is multiplied by K: account it as debt, or the target grows.

evidence.text: Broad timer windows counted wrapper work as original producer time and regressed pace.
evidence.quote: Broad timer windows counted wrapper work as original producer time and regressed pace.
